scenarios.name: Choose a face after starting Zoom Selected

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid active in the MCAD Software
its visible planar face appears small within the viewport
the user chooses Zoom Selected from the navigation bar Zoom menu
the status area prompts the user to select an entity to zoom
the user clicks the visible planar face
the face appears larger and fills most of the viewport
the face is no longer highlighted as selected
the same part and orientation remain active
